notes: Key contact: Priya Raman (Head of Product). Wants deterministic relevance improvements for product search and knowledge base retrieval.
Use-case specifics: pipeline is candidate generation (BM25) -> rerank top-200. Offline scoring for nightly batch + online re-rank for interactive search.
Performance targets: median latency for rerank call <= 150ms (P95 < 350ms) for 200 qps; acceptable tradeoff: slightly higher latency for improved precision@10.
Throughput: stable 150-250 qps; burst capacity to 1000 qps during promos. POC implemented with Hosted API; prefer Dedicated for production due to cost predictability and VPC isolation.
Model preferences: open-weight friendly (LLAMA2/Redwood-verified variants) with quantized deployment. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization & batching).
Evaluation: provided a 10k query gold set with judged relevance scores. Want integrated eval dashboards and automated regression alerts tied to eval set.
Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 90 days+, and ability to route requests through customer's VPC. KMS integration required for prod keys.
Quote from Priya: 'If we can get a reliable +10% relevance lift with predictable cost, this is a no-brainer.'
Finance: wants committed monthly capacity pricing for Dedicated to model unit economics; worried about tokenized per-request surprises.
Technical note from SE: tested offline scorer on subset; ranking improvements come primarily from better conversational context handling and query rewriting in reranker.
Staging plan: Hosted API for POC and soak; Dedicated for 99.9% uptime SLA and traffic isolation once SOW signed. Evaluate Optimize recommendations during POC.
